summary: Verified 502 bug fix: countryCode→territoryCode rename applied correctly across all 5 locations. All 13 backend tests pass. Frontend home screen loads with Shopify catalog data.
critical_code_review_comments: Code review confirms: no 'countryCode' in customer_account_client.py, schemas.py, auth.ts, or addresses.tsx — all use 'territoryCode' correctly.
ME_QUERY, ADDRESS_CREATE_MUTATION, ADDRESS_UPDATE_MUTATION all use territoryCode.
Frontend AddressInput type and addresses.tsx form both use territoryCode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 502 bug fix verified. territoryCode is used correctly everywhere. Token-exchange end-to-end cannot be tested without a real Shopify OAuth flow on a native device.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: ME_QUERY and address mutations used 'countryCode' which does not exist in Shopify Customer Account API 2026-07 schema. Shopify returned HTTP 400, which the error handler re-threw as CustomerAccountAPIError(502). Fix: renamed countryCode→territoryCode in all 5 locations. Verified by grep (no countryCode found) and all 13 pytest tests passing.
